scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma db push --skip-generate && node prisma/seed.mjs && UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('.next/standalone')){fs.mkdirSync('.next/standalone/prisma',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('prisma/dev.db','.next/standalone/prisma/dev.db');fs.copyFileSync('prisma/schema.prisma','.next/standalone/prisma/schema.prisma');}"
scripts.start: ./node_modules/.bin/prisma db push --skip-generate && node prisma/seed.mjs && next start
